snippet.title: DeadRoot Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show Summer Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist here - store.steampowered.com/app/2374540

A world premiere trailer gave us a closer look at DeadRoot, a medieval metroidvania with a charming cartoon art style. It stars a plucky little snail who is armed to the teeth, and it's coming soon to PC.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
